Live Music in broomfield
100 Nickel at Chipper’s Lanes

Come for live music, DJs, or karaoke in Broomfield!

Live on the Lanes at 100 Nickel inside Chipper’s Lanes is sure to be a new favorite music venue.

good to know

  • Some concerts are free, and some require a paid ticket. Please see each individual event for details.
  • All ages are welcome. Must be 21+ to sit at the bar.
  • Concerts are standing room only along the concourse of the venue. Seating is available with the purchase of bowling in one of our lanes.
  • Food and drink service is available from the bar area.
  • Bowling is concurrently available for purchase during concerts on a first-come, first-served basis. Check out our special Live on the Lanes unlimited bowling deal available during concerts!

I love this place. It's a fun and affordable spot to go have some fun, and to watch music! They setup a stage in the middle lanes and offer a dance floor or you can Boll and have some fun while you watch. The bands are always great and I have an awesome time.
A.E.B.
Experienced a first for me - a concert at a bowling alley??? What? Anyway, it was fantastic and I had a lot of fun. The sound system was great. Can't get more punk rock than that 🤘🏻
Ashley A.
I had so much fun here! I saw an awesome band called Purple Blues. This was a great venue for a concert and so much fun bowling and also has a great arcade and laser tag!
Amber R.
This place is awesome!!!! I haven't bowled in a long time but these guys really took care of us. Sue and Ashley really took care of us like we were a part of the family. They have everything here from amazing deep dish pizza, awesome music, full bar, and arcade for the kids if they aren't learning to bowl. I had a great time with my co-workers here on a Saturday night. Thank you!!!!!
Justin C.
